ritual.sakura_bloom.hint: Light the four red candles two blocks from the matching sanctum altar, then use the seal on it.
ritual.sakura_bloom.location: This seal answers only within its Interstice sanctum.
ritual.sakura_bloom.peaceful: The guardian sleeps on Peaceful difficulty.
ritual.sakura_bloom.candles: Light a red candle two blocks from the altar in each cardinal direction.
advancements.sakura_bloom.night_watch.de: Bring a sakura talisman to a shrine. Speak with the maiden or make an offering.
Open a Knotwork Pouch and fit your charms into its woven grid.
advancements.sakura_bloom.beyond_the_vei: A Maple Leaf Opens the Way
Complete a maiden's commission cycle. Wave the maple fan to cross into the Interstice.
advancements.sakura_bloom.four_candles.d: Light the four red candles at a matching sanctum, then offer its seal at the central altar.
advancements.sakura_bloom.keeper_falls.d: Defeat a sanctum guardian. Use its heart to craft a relic or reforge a diamond sword.
